title: Beef Fajita Wrap
description: Savory beef and vegetables wrapped in a warm tortilla, perfect for a quick dinner. This recipe is inspired by traditional Mexican cuisine.

ingredients.name: Flank Steak
ingredients.notes: Slice into thin strips for fajita-style cooking

ingredients.name: Shredded Cheese
ingredients.notes: Monterey Jack or Cheddar work well

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper; cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced beef; cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing a portion of the beef and vegetable mixture onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of salsa and shredded cheese.
Serve hot, with sour cream and cilantro on the side if desired.
Repeat with remaining ingredients and serve immediately.
